title: What's a Starfish Doing on the Doorpost?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)
the owner's naming rule (2026-11-15): a person the draft names by role is a cast villager, named at the first mention

collection.description: A villager finds a bright orange starfish clinging to the doorpost, a long way from the sea.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) steps out of (subject.his/her) hut in the morning and finds a starfish stuck to the doorpost, about head high. It's alive. It's bright orange. It's a long way from the sea. It is clinging to the wood with all five arms, as if it fully intends to stay.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) peels it off very gently, which takes a long time, because it really doesn't want to come off, and carries it to the tide pools. (subject.He/She) lowers it in. It settles onto a rock, apparently happy. When (subject) gets home, (subject.he/she) looks at the doorpost for a while, half expecting it to be back.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) knocks on doors. Has anybody seen a starfish climbing up a doorpost? Nobody has. (friend) suggests a seabird dropped it. (child), a child, admits to having carried "a starfish" up from the beach yesterday, but swears (child.he/she) put it down "somewhere safe." (subject) looks at the doorpost. It is, in fairness, quite a safe spot. (subject.He/She) takes the starfish home to the sea anyway.
